title: Turnep
summary: TUR'NEP, noun [Latin napus, a turnep ] A bulbous root or plant of the genus Brassica, of great value for food; an esculent root of several varieties.

inlines.v: TUR'NEP, noun [Latin napus, a turnep ] A bulbous root or plant of the genus Brassica, of great value for food; an esculent root of several varieties.
